entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Hello? I... I need some help. I think I need to return something but I'm just so confused by the whole process.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Diana. I can certainly help you with that. Can I start with your name and order number, please?
Yes, it's Mark Peterson. The order number is... uh... VF789012.

Thank you, Mark. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see your order for the Men's Velocity Jersey, delivered on November 18th. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the item? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?

Oh, I'm not sure. It's just the wrong size, I think. I finally got around to trying on the jersey and it's just way too tight across the shoulders. I wanted to do an exchange, but I couldn't figure it out on your website. Can't you just help me?
Of course, Mark. I can absolutely take care of this for you. I see the delivery was 48 days ago, and for a standard item like a jersey, you're well within our 90-day return policy.
Oh, it's that long? That's such a relief. I was so worried I had missed the window.

Not at all, you're perfectly fine. I've just started the return process in our system. I can email you a prepaid shipping label right now. You can use that to send the original jersey back to us. Would you prefer a full refund, or would you like me to set up the exchange for the next size up?
The exchange would be wonderful, thank you so much! You've made this so easy.
You're very welcome, Mark. I've just sent that email with the label and confirmed the exchange order for you. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that was it. Thank you again, Diana.
It was my pleasure. Have a great day and enjoy your new jersey when it arrives!
